ideas.pitch: An AI agent that autonomously ingests regional environmental compliance codes and cross-references them with live satellite telemetry to flag zoning violations before inspectors arrive.
ideas.problem_statement: Smart Technology Solutions: IoT, connected devices, and emerging technologies / AI Agents & Automation
ideas.title: RegulAI: Autonomous Environmental Compliance Agent for Industrial Zones
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high-difficulty satellite data processing with automated agent workflows, echoing the technical depth of GeoNex-ATLAS which won at a similar regional innovation hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An investigative dashboard utilizing graph intelligence and explainable machine learning models to detect complex anti-money laundering typologies in real-time transaction streams.
ideas.problem_statement: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning: Intelligent systems, predictive solutions, and AI-powered applications
ideas.title: FinSight AI: Graph-Based AML Investigation Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly replicates the architecture of Bito, proving that enterprise-grade risk detection systems score exceptionally well with technical judging panels.

ideas.pitch: A mobile web application that captures user running gaits via device cameras and runs real-time MediaPipe pose estimation with confidence gating to prevent lower-limb injuries.
ideas.problem_statement: Mobile Application Development: Innovative Android and iOS applications
ideas.title: AeroPose: Biomechanical Runner Form Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages client-side computer vision for instant utility, following the proven formula of CricketVision_AI which won first prize at NeuroForge.

ideas.pitch: A platform that transforms raw screen-recordings of standard operating procedures into fully searchable, interactive text transcripts and step-by-step guides automatically.
ideas.problem_statement: Software & SaaS Products: Productivity tools, platforms, and software-based innovations
ideas.title: DocuPulse AI: Unstructured Video Intelligence for Technical SOPs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate enterprise pain point of knowledge retention, directly matching the data-to-value conversion strategy that won LibrAI first prize.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered interview coach that parses candidate resumes to dynamically generate role-specific technical grilling sessions with live audio feedback and scorecards.
ideas.problem_statement: Web Applications & Websites: Modern, scalable, and interactive digital platforms
ideas.title: NeuroCoach AI: Resume-Driven Technical Interview Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on high-utility career enablement with a polished user experience, mirroring the runner-up success of HireSenseAi at the StepsAI National Hackathon.
